Pinned browser dependencies, served locally without a runtime CDN:

- JsBarcode 3.12.3, CODE128-only build, MIT: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
- qrcode-generator 2.0.4, MIT: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Sources are the corresponding npm registry release tarballs. License notices are retained beside the scripts and in their headers. `demo-tools.js` owns product-specific rendering and print preparation; vendor files are unmodified.
